name: Pei
class: Assassin — Roving Assassin / Ranged Harass/Cleanup / Early Game

skills.name: Blast
skills.text: In human form, Basic Attacks have increased range and deal extra magical damage while recovering Energy. Consecutive hits on the same target will stack damage.

skills.name: Striker Stance
skills.text: Fires Inner Energy in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in its path and slowing them. Recovers Energy upon hit.

skills.name: Guarding Stance
skills.text: Gains a shield and Attack Speed. Deals damage to enemies within range and continues to deal damage over time.

skills.name: Tiger Form
skills.text: Switches to tiger form, gaining Movement Speed and enhancing the next 2 Basic Attacks. The 1st Basic Attack lets him dash toward a locked-on target, damaging and slowing them. The 2nd Basic Attack deals magical damage.

skills.name: Beastly Instincts
skills.text: Gains extra Physical Attack, Physical Defense, Magical Defense, and Movement Speed while in tiger form.

skills.name: Roaring Tiger Stance
skills.text: Bites enemies, dealing damage. Restores Energy when this attack defeats an enemy.

skills.name: Leaping Tiger Stance
skills.text: Pounces in the target direction. If runs into terrain, latches onto it briefly and can pounce again. If the pounce hits an enemy, he deals damage, recovers Energy, and reduces this skill's cooldown.

skills.name: Human Form
skills.text: Switches to human form, gains Movement Speed and enhances the next Basic Attack. Deals damage to the target and enemies in a cone-shaped area behind them.
